SWZ.note: Notice states nothing on rural internet access or use.
The 2% Universal Access and Service Fund contribution is only a proposed decision, not yet a levy in force.
Notice states nothing on online government services.

facts.fact: The Eswatini Communications Commission published on its website a proposed broadcasting licence fee schedule and invited written comments from stakeholders and the public by email until 11 August 2025.
The Eswatini Communications Commission invited written comments from all interested stakeholders and the public on its proposed broadcasting licence fee schedule, with a deadline of 11 August 2025.

SWZ.note: Notice calls the process one 'contemplated by Section 32' of the ESCCOM Act; it does not say the law requires it, so no standing fact.
Notice states no rural electricity access figure.
